status: normative machine-readable SSOT; not a completion claim

authority.role: sole normative owner of visual acceptance values

principle.rule: a later tier cannot compensate for an earlier failure

geometry_each_scale.measurement: Actual glyph, stroke and marker envelopes after all transforms, clipping and viewport scaling; analytic, browser and raster observations bind the same artifact.

typography_and_accessibility.primary_language: English with one bounded Chinese brand mark
typography_and_accessibility.measurement: Actual painted glyph bounds and composed CTM at every declared viewport; source font size alone is insufficient.

risk_mutation_coverage.policy: finite risk-directed counterexamples; every declared P0 class and required mutation must be killed

owner_acceptance.role: product owner judgment after machine and authority closure

soft_metrics.guidance: retain only epsilon-Pareto-nondominated feasible candidates; do not collapse to one weighted score

anti_goodhart.edge_length_uniformity: semantic distance and hierarchy outrank equal lengths
anti_goodhart.density: cannot reduce whitespace below label and grouping margins
anti_goodhart.symmetry: no reward unless it preserves causal asymmetry
anti_goodhart.label_reduction: Never remove required meaning or reduce legibility to meet word, character or object counts.
anti_goodhart.crossings: any crossing on the critical path is hard fail; crossing angle is not compensation
anti_goodhart.aesthetics: product-owner judgment may select among already feasible candidates but is not a machine gate

required_evidence: canonical typed graph and source digests
declared view quotient and graph-view-SVG mapping
SVG and PNG at all scales
semantic, principle, geometry, edge, contrast, robustness and mutation reports
complete risk-class-to-killed-mutation coverage from this contract
reproducible generator, solver parameters, fonts and renderer versions
Actual static main-view readability for every required assertion; metadata and hover do not satisfy coverage
Source-defined assurance obligations, independent medium-specific faithfulness review and qualified or explicitly absent predecessor.

semantic_identity.scope: Every selected semantic entity, relation, interpretation stage and obligation owner.
evidence: Exact source-to-graph and graph-to-view disposition for identity, type, lifetime, ownership and source constraints.
Positive and negative interpretation examples, including accepted versus unresolved source meaning and pure decision versus effect.
An obligation has one definition and acceptance owner; multiple explicit medium/state/evidence-plane references are permitted and do not duplicate that definition.
reject_when: A root, lifetime, accepted interpretation or authority is changed by an adapter or presentation.
A unique obligation disappears, gains multiple owners, or is replaced by a task/experiment/feedback database.
Typed endpoints, proposition identity or provenance are absent or contradictory.

claim_boundaries.scope: Each claim of capability, evidence, current implementation, delivery or observed benefit.
evidence: Claim subject, predicate, scope, evidence plane, exact bindings, validity and verifier provenance.
Actual observations for current implementation and benefit claims; an explicit source rule for any composed claim.
reject_when: A hash, signature, test, delivery or inherited report is treated as independent identity, current authority or realized benefit.
Evidence planes amplify one another without a declared rule, or optional independent verification becomes a universal blocker.
Target or optional capability is portrayed as current delivered behavior without matching evidence.

effect_admission.scope: Every independently admitted resource effect and its complete local control/effect ingress.
evidence: Typed local contract showing required-input conjunction, all verdict exits, fresh recheck, admitted effect, post-observation and Attestation.
Reachability and dominance checks over declared control/effect relations, plus a counterexample removing each required prerequisite.
reject_when: An effect bypasses its gate, PASS, fresh recheck, runner, post-observation or exact result binding.
BLOCK, required UNKNOWN, contradiction or missing model facts lead to effects.
Candidate and accepted CAS collapse, a boundary lacks its own linearization point, or local transactions imply global atomicity.

authority_non_amplification.scope: All capability, evidence, projection, adopter and cross-repository authority relationships.
evidence: Declared typed paths with exact source authority, subject and boundaries.
Counterexamples that connect a capability, report, projection or exchanged artifact directly to an effect.
reject_when: A capability, proof, coordination record, projection or conformance result grants effect authority.
An adapter reverse-owns source meaning or an autonomous repository exports its authority.
A domain profile loses native layout or judgment because of a shared projection.

recovery_and_conservation.scope: Unknown outcomes, interruptions and actor/session/host loss for every declared effect.
evidence: Recovery traces distinguishing no attempt, observed failure and unknown effect outcome.
Exact surviving Git/result identities and a fresh-observation/recompilation path before a subsequent effect.
reject_when: An unknown outcome is blindly replayed or historical success is reused as current permission.
Session or tool loss destroys the sole valuable result or requires reconstruction from Agent memory.

collaboration_and_integration.scope: All work lanes, their individual admission, collaboration selection, review and two integration boundaries.
evidence: Per-lane Lease and fresh source facts; composition checks for the exact accepted object and changed baseline.
Cooperation with multiple contributions, competition with zero or one, exploration and all-drop traces with conserved useful results.
Distinct work/candidate/proposal/dev/main roles and proposal retirement after dev acceptance and review closure.
reject_when: Shared layout transfers one lane's permission to another, or same-ref serialization implies all work is serial.
Competition invents a mandatory winner, all-drop destroys useful results, or stale proofs survive baseline changes.
Review requires an already accepted product or proposal retirement incorrectly waits for main.

product_and_adoption.scope: The complete product path, greenfield and brownfield origins, runtime family and independent publication targets.
evidence: Source-backed complete path from value/research/interpretation through accepted intent, capability composition, work, verification, delivery, actual use, learning and exit.
Distinct formation, gradual adoption, customization, upgrade, handoff and exit with runtime activation and rollback boundaries.
Local object identity and separately observed zero/one/multiple target outcomes.
reject_when: The product is reduced to its compiler/CAS kernel, code index or a particular Agent/model.
Brownfield is treated as greenfield, a publication mirror as an autonomous adopter, or deployment as benefit.
Runtime activation/migration/rebinding/rollback or target-local publication obligations disappear.

visible_semantic_preservation.scope: Every required proposition in the declared rendered medium and view scope.
evidence: The exact visible text, typed relationship or intelligible aggregate supporting each source obligation.
Actual glyph/paint and navigation observations at required viewports plus independent source-to-artifact review.
reject_when: IDs, hidden SVG witnesses, hover, off-scope pages or co-located labels substitute for intelligible required meaning.
A mechanical text/object budget drops a required distinction or reduces legibility.

principle_review.scope: The original root constraint, engineering axioms and construction discipline as applied to this exact projection.
evidence: Exact source sections, a reasoned source-to-design assessment and counterexamples that would change the judgment.
Review of authority, preserved distinctions, one owner, minimum necessary structure and native capability boundaries.
reject_when: A copied slogan, check count, aesthetic preference or passing graph test substitutes for source-grounded reasoning.
A local diagram convenience changes product meaning, restores parallel authority or removes a necessary distinction.

faithfulness.scope: Semantic preservation of the complete declared source scope on each exact delivered medium; not an extra product component.
evidence: Independent source-to-artifact review with exact reviewer identity/boundary, artifact and source bindings, observed assertions and counterexamples.
The reviewer evaluates original propositions and visible relationships rather than trusting a renderer's self-report or shared test implementation.
Keep source-declaration validation, source-graph judgment, independent source-to-artifact review, rendered geometry/legibility and final owner acceptance distinct; none silently discharges another.
reject_when: Faithfulness is asserted from mapping counts, exact hashes, protocol-scope labels or hidden witnesses alone.
An authored report is claimed as independent review, a required gap is hidden, or only part of the declared artifact scope is reviewed.

static_overview.scope: One static overview at every required viewport; its main view is the complete reading surface.
evidence: Visible witness or intelligible aggregate for every required assertion and typed relationship.
Observed glyphs, all paint envelopes and whole-view reading order on the exact SVG/raster artifact.
reject_when: A required predicate, scope, outcome or causal direction can be recovered only from metadata, hover or another unannounced artifact.
Compression changes meaning, disguises an omission or makes required text unreadable.

navigable_atlas.scope: The explicitly selected atlas including its overview, named pages, visible navigation and every required route.
evidence: A visible scope map and navigation route from each overview aggregate to its exact detailed witness.
Page-specific glyph/paint/interaction evidence and complete source-to-page disposition; the overview preserves essential authority and causal distinctions.
reject_when: Unvisited, unreachable or unnamed pages are counted as coverage.
Page-local success is generalized to the entire atlas, or interaction hides a distinction required for understanding an overview relation.

scoped_view.scope: An explicitly bounded guided story, presentation, shared view, excerpt or export; the currently visible state is its reading surface.
evidence: The visible declared scope and all necessary identity, authority, conditions and outcome distinctions of every expressed relationship.
State-specific source-to-artifact review and painted evidence; a route to a complete document does not substitute for conditions needed to interpret the current view.
reject_when: The view implies whole-product completeness while declaring or showing only a subset.
Hidden JSON, hidden document prose, hover or leaving presentation mode is required to recover an essential guard, identity or authority boundary.
Optional omitted detail is treated as a failure despite no loss of meaning within the explicitly bounded view.

predecessor.scope: Comparison with a specific prior artifact under compatible source scope and applicable acceptance policy; never product or effect authority.
evidence: Exact prior artifact/source/quality identities, observed evidence, review decision and statement-by-statement applicability to the candidate.
Trusted prestate policy plus explicit source review for changed quality meaning; comparable metric definitions, medium, viewport and evidence plane.
reject_when: A prior PASS without verified identity, scope or evidence is used as the floor.
A candidate loosens its own rule or copies a report to qualify itself.
No qualified predecessor is misreported as automatic improvement, regression, or a reason to waive absolute acceptance.
